MasulloGRH.stripWeight_translate_bound (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (d : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
  stripWeight α d (x + y) ≤ Real.exp (2 * α * |y|) * (2 * (1 + y ^ 2)) ^ d * stripWeight α d x
'MasulloGRH.stripWeight_translate_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.lifted_amplitude_translate_bound (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (d : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) (v : ℂ) :
  ‖v‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α d (x + y) ≤ Real.exp (2 * α * |y|) * (2 * (1 + y ^ 2)) ^ d * (‖v‖ ^ 2 * stripWeight α d x)
'MasulloGRH.lifted_amplitude_translate_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineConvolution_lift_change.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (φ u h : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K)
  (hu : Integrable (fun g => φ g * u (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) (hh : Integrable (fun g => φ g * h (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) :
  ideleClassConvolution K μ φ (fun y => u y + h y) x = ideleClassConvolution K μ φ u x + ideleClassConvolution K μ φ h x
'MasulloGRH.genuineConvolution_lift_change' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineConvolution_lift_leakage_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (φ u h : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K)
  (hu : Integrable (fun g => φ g * u (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) (hh : Integrable (fun g => φ g * h (g⁻¹ * x)) μ) :
  ‖ideleClassConvolution K μ φ h x‖ ≤
    ‖ideleClassConvolution K μ φ (fun y => u y + h y) x‖ + ‖ideleClassConvolution K μ φ u x‖
'MasulloGRH.genuineConvolution_lift_leakage_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
